items.exampleEn: After a long discussion, we chose the red car in the end.
items.exampleZh: 討論了很久之後，我們最後選了那輛紅色的車。

items.exampleEn: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm in a hurry.
items.exampleZh: 抱歉，我現在不能聊，我在趕時間。

items.exampleEn: She isn't here. Would you like to leave a message?
One kind word can make a difference.
items.exampleZh: 一句好話就能帶來影響。

items.exampleEn: I checked twice to make sure the door was locked.
items.exampleZh: 我檢查了兩次，確定門有鎖好。

items.exampleEn: Did you leave the door open on purpose?
items.exampleZh: 你是故意讓門開著的嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Please leave me a message, and I will call you back.
items.sentenceZh: 請留言給我，我會回你電話。

items.audioEn: He was in a hurry this morning, so he forgot his lunch at home.
items.audioZh: 他今天早上很匆忙，所以把午餐忘在家裡了。
options: He missed his bus to work

items.sentenceEn: Teachers can make a difference in children's lives.
items.sentenceZh: 老師可以對孩子的人生帶來影響。

items.sentenceEn: Make sure you write your name on the paper.
items.sentenceZh: 務必在紙上寫上你的名字。

items.stemEn: She smiled and said sorry. I don't think she pushed me ____.
items.stemZh: 她笑著說了對不起。我不認為她是故意推我的。

items.stemEn: The new lights ____ to our street; it feels much safer at night.
items.stemZh: 新的路燈讓我們這條街大不相同，晚上感覺安全多了。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, Lily was in a hurry to catch the train to her aunt's city, and she set off without her phone. At the station, she found out that the train was late. She wanted to tell her aunt, so she borrowed a phone and left a message for her. When Lily arrived, her aunt was waiting at the gate. "I got your message," she said with a smile. In the end, the trip was fun, but now Lily always makes sure her phone is in her bag before she leaves home.
items.passageZh: 上週六，Lily 急著趕火車去阿姨住的城市，出發時沒帶手機。到了車站，她發現火車誤點了。她想告訴阿姨，於是借了一支手機留言給她。Lily 抵達時，阿姨已經在出口等她。她笑著說：「我收到你的留言了。」最後這趟旅行很開心，但現在 Lily 出門前總會確認手機在包包裡。

questions.questionZh: Lily 為什麼要用別人的手機？
options: 打電話給朋友問怎麼走

questions.questionZh: Lily 現在出門前會做什麼？

items.promptZh: 昨天我們等了很久，最後公車終於來了。
referenceEn: Yesterday we waited a long time, and in the end the bus came.
We waited for a long time yesterday. In the end, the bus came.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 in the end 等，可放句首或句尾；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 finally、at last 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 waited、came 等）
「終於」可省略，也可寫，例如 finally 等

items.promptZh: 我妹妹故意把最大塊的蛋糕留給我。
referenceEn: My sister saved the biggest piece of cake for me on purpose.
My younger sister saved the biggest piece of cake for me on purpose.
My sister kept the biggest piece of cake for me on purpose.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 on purpose 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 deliberately、intentionally 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 saved、has saved 等）
「留給我」可寫，例如 saved … for me、kept … for me、left … for me 等
